hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored fuzzyEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy BIT-FOR-BIT across (dimension, r); at m=2, r=0.2 it differs from the crisp sample entropy (the soft exponential membership counts partial matches the Heaviside step does not), and it is non-increasing in the embedding dimension.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: fuzzyEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across (dimension, r); it differs from the crisp sample entropy at the same (m, r)
